input: Sign up for a community sailing course

gold.taskTitle: Sign Up for a Community Sailing Course
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and enroll in a community sailing course.

questions.title: What is your current sailing experience level?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is a complete beginner, has some basic experience, or is looking to advance existing skills.

questions.title: Which city or area should the course be in?
questions.description: Identify the geographic location where the user wants to find a sailing course.

questions.title: Do you have a target start date in mind?
questions.description: Determine when the user wants the course to begin so suitable options can be identified.

questions.title: How many days or weeks can you commit to this?
questions.description: Clarify the user's availability and preferred course duration or intensity.

questions.title: What is your budget for the course fees?
questions.description: Understand any financial constraints that would filter which courses are realistic options.

questions.title: Are you aiming for a recognised sailing certification?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants an accredited qualification such as an RYA or ASA certification, or just recreational learning.

questions.title: Will you be attending alone or with others?
questions.description: Determine if the user needs to register one person or coordinate group enrollment with friends or family.
